blocks.html: This Maundy Thursday (April 2) all Robinsons Malls will be closed expect for Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita, Summit Ridge Promenade, Robinsons Place Malolos, Robinsons Place Pangasinan, Robinsons Place Palawan, Robinsons Place Santiago and Robinsons Starmills Pampanga.
On April 3, Good Friday, only Robinsons Place Antipolo, Robinsons Luisita and Summit Ridge Promenade will be operational.
Regular mall operating hours will resume on Black Saturday, April 4.
For more information, you may check www.robinsonsmalls.com or www.facebook.com/RobinsonsMalls
